### FITB — Integration progress supports earnings growth

**Reported GAAP diluted EPS increased to $0.90 from $0.83 in 2Q26**, an improvement of $0.07. Adjusted EPS was $1.13 after excluding $0.23 per share of specified charges [B0067, B0008]. Net income available to common shareholders increased to $828 million from $763 million [B0066].

**Underlying earnings:** The $211 million after-tax adjustment comprised merger-related costs, interchange litigation and technology-related impairments [B0071–B0075]. Management reported sequential improvement in adjusted pre-provision earnings and positive operating leverage as Comerica integration continued [B0016, B0048].

**Revenue and margin:** GAAP NII grew $56 million to $2,271 million, though FTE NIM contracted 2 basis points to 3.34%. Noninterest income declined to $1,008 million, while expenses fell $60 million to $2,049 million [B0024, B0091, B0059, B0060].

**Credit:** Provision decreased to $122 million from $129 million. Net charge-offs were $139 million, representing an annualized 0.31% ratio, and ACL coverage stood at 1.74% [B0058, B0267, B0268, B0261].

**Capital and returns:** CET1 increased to 10.02%, and reported ROTCE improved to 16.6%. Tangible book value was $22.01 per share. No common shares were repurchased during the quarter [B0043, B0042, B0032, B0292].

**Guidance:** No explicit numerical revision to forward earnings guidance was identified in the supplied release.

**Investment thesis:** Modestly positive. Expense discipline and integration progress support profitability, although margin compression, fee weakness and acquisition execution warrant continued monitoring.
